name: Orbclo Dev Orbit
author: onisY
description: Controlled rollback after V0.69 CAL ERR. Restore the V0.68 calendar renderer that was known to display on hardware, remove the new prepared-page cache entirely, but keep RAM-only date handoff and readable timing/selection diagnostics. Calendar startup errors now show the actual exception text under CAL ERR. Normal calendar startup shows T/D/P timings; selection shows SEL/ERR and DT.
